dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Two failed Get-MigrationPattern.ps1 calls guessing the manifest anchor, then a fallback grep of MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md to discover the real heading names.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: The manifest migration guidance — a universal step every UWP->WinUI 3 conversion needs — has no retrievable <a id> anchor; it is buried as h3 subsections under the 'csproj' anchor, and SKILL.md points at a non-fetchable markdown slug.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Agent grepped '^##' headings to enumerate sections, then read the file region directly.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Add an <a id="manifest"> anchor to the manifest section and reference -Anchor manifest from SKILL.md's project-file step and validator manifest note.
